activity.notes: Jan Hus took charge of Prague's Bethlehem Chapel in 1402 and became the leading Czech ecclesiastical reform voice before his execution at Constance on 6 July 1415. ATLAS records this bounded reform/preaching activity in the Kingdom of Bohemia rather than his full lifespan.

sources.title: Hus, Jan (c.1369–1415) — Routledge Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: The Routledge Encyclopedia states that from his appointment as rector of Bethlehem Chapel in Prague in 1402 until his execution in 1415, Hus advanced the Czech ecclesiastical reform movement.
